component.name: xLights
component.summary: Sequence and control lighting displays for holiday and event shows

description.p: xLights is a free, open-source program that enables you to design, create, and play amazing lighting displays through the use of DMX controllers, E1.31 (sACN), ArtNet, DDP, and other protocols.

ul.li: Timeline-based sequence editor with 50+ built-in effects
Upload support for FPP, Falcon, WLED, HinksPix, Minleon, and many more
Audio synchronisation and phoneme-based lip sync
Morph, Shader, Video, Picture, Glediator, and many other effects
